note: A living commons of validated leverage. Each entry carries the transferable technique behind a result, not just the number, so setups like yours can adopt what worked. Opt-in, anonymized: technique + numbers travel; identities, repos, and code never do. See frontier/README.md.

axes.cache_read_pct: cache-read share of input tokens (higher better)

entries.technique: One strong model does the whole task in-session, no delegation. Simple, low-waste baseline; keeps the most of what it writes.
Orchestrator plans and reviews; a worker subagent does implementation. Higher throughput per output-token than solo, at more waste, best when the orchestrator reviews tightly.

Fan out independent parts as a parallel workflow, then synthesize. Fast and low human-attention, but the highest same-session waste in this seed, a candidate for pairing with a review pass to lift survival.
